data.narrative:
Zettascale is a Seed-stage semiconductor company founded by Elias Almqvist (CEO) and Prithvi Raj (CTO), having raised $3M+. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 3 private and 3 public comparables in Chips & Semiconductors, including Series A companies SambaNova Systems, Rebellions, and d-Matrix, alongside public anchors ALAB, NVDA, and AMD.

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-Progression uses the $3M raised as a base proxy and applies a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage multiplier, yielding $8M. Peer-Median anchors to the three same-sector comparables: SambaNova at $11.0B, Rebellions at $2.3B, and d-Matrix at $2.0B, with a median valuation of $2.3B. Public-Comp Anchoring is not applicable; while the Semiconductors sector median trades at 20.5x price-to-sales across the three public tickers, Zettascale's revenue is not disclosed. 

The triangulated range spans $6M (low) to $2.7B (high), with a median of $1.2B. This wide spread reflects tension between early-stage funding history and late-stage peer comparables. The Stage-Progression method supports a more conservative posture; Peer-Median valuations carry material uncertainty given significant heterogeneity in the comp set ($2.0B–$11.0B) and the absence of revenue visibility to validate multiples.
